# Lumina XP — Human Centered Experience Platform

> Lumina XP is a B2B Adaptive Experience Platform that maps corporate team challenges to personalized experiential journeys powered by AI analysis.

## What Lumina XP Does

Lumina XP helps companies transform team challenges (burnout, weak leadership, team dysfunction, lack of innovation) into tailored 3-day experiential programs. The platform uses Lumina AI, a semantic analysis engine, to match business challenges with the right combination of 10+ world-class experts across 4 experience dimensions.

## The 4 Experience Clusters

- **PLAY** — Team engagement, sports, synchronization, bonding (Olympic athletes, sports events)
- **SENSE** — Wellness, nutrition, posture, olfactory experiences, body awareness
- **LEARN** — AI/automation training, leadership coaching, storytelling, process optimization
- **IMMERSIVE** — Retreats, high-impact events, celebrations, transformative experiences

## How Lumina AI Works

1. User selects a challenge category (team dysfunction, weak leadership, stress/burnout, innovation, reward, memorable event)
2. Describes their specific situation in free text
3. Answers 3 guided questions (industry sector, root cause, team size)
4. Lumina AI analyzes the input using 500+ Italian semantic stems, phrase matching, and intent detection
5. Generates a personalized 3-day itinerary with top 3 matched experts, cluster activation scores, and sector-specific insights

## Services Offered

- **Corporate Retreats** — 3-day immersive programs in exclusive locations
- **AI Training** — Operational AI and automation training (n8n, ChatGPT, workflow optimization)
- **Team Building** — Activities with Olympic champions and professional coaches
- **Sensory Laboratories** — Olfactory design, nutrition workshops, body language training
- **Leadership Coaching** — Executive coaching, strategic decision-making, storytelling

## Training Tiers

- **Lumina Starter** — First structured AI entry for SMBs (10-30 employees)
- **Lumina Core** — Complete transformation with AI, workflows, and coaching
- **Lumina Elite** — Total AI integration for mid-market companies (100-250 employees)
